page_title: VAL 2-0 CAD | Valencia v Cadiz CF 23/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+3' Giorgi Mamardashvili was forced into action to thwart Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
90+2' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) for his blatant foul.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
90' Roger Marti (Cadiz) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
90' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
89' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a great save to deny Lucas Pires (Cadiz), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
88' Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) commits a rough foul. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes stops the game and makes a call.
87' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
86' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
85' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
84' Here is a change. Diego Lopez is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia).
84' Substitution. Pablo Gozalbez (Valencia) on for Fran Perez.
83' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
83' Pepelu (Valencia) will take the corner.
83' Fran Perez (Valencia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and Valencia manage to earn a corner.
81' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
80' The attendance for today's match is 41647.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is replacing Gonzalo Escalante.
78' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) has a goal ruled out for offside!
77' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

76' Diego Lopez (Valencia) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
75' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Thierry Correia is replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
75' The substitution is prepared. Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Duro.
73' Jose Gaya (Valencia) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' What was Fali (Cadiz) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
70' The resulting free kick from Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
68' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
68' Thierry Correia (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
67' Javi Guerra (Valencia) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Selim Amallah leaves the pitch and Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) comes on.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Chris Ramos as he is replaced by Roger Marti (Cadiz).
65' Sergio decides to make a substitution. Maximiliano Gomez will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
62' Fali (Cadiz) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
61' Flag up against Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
59' Rough tackle by Javi Guerra (Valencia). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) brings his opponent down. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' Cadiz CF take a short corner kick.
55' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
54' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
54' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Cadiz CF will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Fran Perez (Valencia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Conan Ledesma, who smothers the ball.
53' Valencia are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
50' Flag goes up against Hugo Duro (Valencia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

50' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
49' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul after Pepelu (Valencia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
48' Half-chance! Chris Ramos (Cadiz) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
46' Half-time substitution. Jorge Mere (Cadiz) will not participate anymore and Lucas Pires is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Sergio probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ivan Alejo. He is replaced by Alex Fernandez (Cadiz).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Jorge Mere (Cadiz) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
45+3' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle. Javi Guerra (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45+1' Valencia are seeing far more of the ball now.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
43' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is penalised for holding. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals a set piece.
41' Pepelu (Valencia) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Conan Ledesma thwarts him with a nice save.
39' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
39' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
39' Thierry Correia (Valencia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
38' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Fran Perez (Valencia) is flagged for offside.
34' Fali (Cadiz) sends a long ball in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comfortably gathers the ball.
32' Fran Perez (Valencia) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
32' Javi Guerra (Valencia) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
29' 3:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
25' 2 - 0 Hugo Duro (Valencia) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
25' Thierry Correia (Valencia) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.
25' Pepelu (Valencia) is able to continue to play.
23' The game is interrupted now, Pepelu (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!
20' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) is penalised for a foul. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' Pepelu (Valencia) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
19' Diego Lopez (Valencia) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.

17' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
17' Selim Amallah (Valencia) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
16' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) tries to find Chris Ramos, but he puts too much power on the pass.
15' Selim Amallah (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Conan Ledesma comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle and it's Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
13' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
13' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
10' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle after Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
9' Selim Amallah (Valencia) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Selim Amallah (Valencia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
6' Half-chance! Diego Lopez (Valencia) plays a pass into the box, but Conan Ledesma reacts well to snuff out the attack.
4' 1 - 0 GOAL! Jose Gaya (Valencia) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Conan Ledesma, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
1' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' The match has just started.
Valencia will kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes was nominated as the referee for this game.
